summary: Venture Global, Inc. filed an 8-K to report a debt refinancing by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Venture Global LNG, Inc., which completed a notes offering of $1.125 billion 6.375% senior secured notes due 2034 and $1.125 billion 6.625% senior secured notes due 2036. Proceeds funded the redemption of outstanding 8.125% senior secured notes due 2028. The notes are secured by collateral and contain standard covenants. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, activist campaign, or restructuring. No premium, stake, or strategic review is involved.
